articles.title: CME, ICE push U.S. regulators to scrutinize Hyperliquid over manipulation risks
articles.snippet: CME Group and ICE have reportedly warned the CFTC and Capitol Hill officials that Hyperliquid’s decentralized perpetual futures platform could enable market manipulation and sanctions evasion.

articles.title: Crypto market structure bill clears key hurdle as ethics debate looms over floor vote
articles.snippet: The Clarity Act cleared the Senate Banking Committee with bipartisan support, setting up a potential full Senate vote within weeks.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward cuts 150 staff, streamlining business ahead of planned IPO
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange is also seeking fresh funding at a $20 billion valuation as it ramps up acquisitions and prepares for a public listing.

articles.title: IREN closes $3 billion convertible notes deal amid AI infrastructure expansion
articles.snippet: Bitcoin miner turned AI infrastructure operator secures one of the sector’s largest financings as investor demand drives multiple upsizes.

articles.title: XRP, DOGE surge 5%, bitcoin above $81,000 as Clarity Act clears Senate banking panel
articles.snippet: Crypto majors bid higher Friday after the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act cleared the Senate Banking Committee in a 15-9 bipartisan vote, with XRP and dogecoin leading the cohort even as broader risk assets sold off on Trump's comments that the US does not need to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
